limitations: Susceptibility is static context, not a forecast or an event observation.
INGEMMET publication/scale and pre-2024 availability remain unverified.
Only polygons intersecting the road axis or sampling points were queried; other territory is unknown.
SENAMHI validity uses the bulletin's local time interpreted as America/Lima; issue time is not supplied.
Official warning levels are not our model risk classes.
Catchment susceptibility proportions are sampled area weights, not a complete polygon-area overlay.
Hydrographic-unit overlap checks broad drainage consistency; it does not delineate a watershed to the road crossing.
Official kilometer calibration remains unverified; source chainage is not silently converted to geometry distance.
